media.owner: the full 2.1 showreel (all five scenes, 60 fps with the client's own sound mixed in) was sent privately

fixes_found_by_the_client_run: the blink sampled the body at a fixed chest offset, so a 2 degree downward look tripped on the ground at step one: it now tests the two blocks the body fills, runs flat within ~11.5 degrees of level and steps up one-block ledges
a mob moves before the end-of-tick sweep, so the first pane stopped the launched body: the sweep now also runs at launch, and speed lost to a pane it smashed is given back

vanilla only sends the player's position while the player is the view entity, so during any cut-scene shot the server did not see the caster's skid: the view returns to the player for client ticks (also applies to the Steam Dash camera)
the trench probe missed the ground once the body was off it; it now scans down to the ground, and starts past the contact point so the caster never skids into it
the crimson aura was drawn as a near-opaque silhouette over the owner's armor; it is now a light glaze, and the ribbons are alpha-blended so they stay crimson over grass and sky
test leaves were decayable and rotted during the 20 s regrowth check; the test and the arena use non-decaying leaves

a GPU client (frame pacing of six afterimages re-rendering the 8K armor; the first third-person frame of the Gyuki set uploads its 8K textures, a one-time stall that QA warms up)
OptiFine and shaderpacks (the inverted frame steps aside like the ink frame)
Bukkit protection plugins on Magma (terrain changes go through BreakEvent and the setBlockState result)
